facts.fact: The Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality (EOS) register lists Egyptian Standard 7982-1/2025, an adoption of IEC 62056-1-0/2014 on electricity metering data exchange (DLMS/COSEM), endorsed 1 October 2025, not obligatory, with ICS code 35.110 among its classes; the page does not state the law that set up the body.

note: No certification fact: the document is a standard register entry and names no certifier or certified organisation. The standard is a metering data-exchange standard, so whether it counts as IT or data is the parent's call.
